# Technovora

> Technovora is a software studio that designs and builds custom software, AI automation, mobile apps, and cloud infrastructure for growing teams. Offices in Sheridan, Wyoming and Hong Kong.

Technovora works with startups and growing companies that need production software shipped by a senior team: fixed-scope quotes in writing before work starts, weekly staging demos, and full code ownership from the first commit. There are no displayed prices or tiers on this site — project estimation happens through a short questionnaire.

## Services

- [AI automation](https://technovora.com/services/ai-automation): AI agents, workflow automation, and custom AI tools that replace manual processes.
- [Web development](https://technovora.com/services/web-development): Next.js web platforms and rebuilds focused on speed and maintainability.
- [Mobile apps](https://technovora.com/services/mobile-apps): Cross-platform and native mobile apps.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://technovora.com/services/cloud-devops): Cloud migrations, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure that scales.
- [Design](https://technovora.com/services/design): UI/UX design, design systems, and prototypes.
- [Social media management](https://technovora.com/services/smm): Content pipelines and social management for B2B teams.

## Key pages

- [About](https://technovora.com/about): Who Technovora is and how the studio works.
- [Project estimation](https://technovora.com/packages): A questionnaire (one question per screen, 6–9 questions per service) that produces a project brief sent to the sales team. No prices are shown.
- [Portfolio](https://technovora.com/portfolio): Selected recent engagements. Client names are withheld where engagements are under NDA.
- [Blog](https://technovora.com/blog): Practical notes on shipping software, using AI agents well, and treating performance as a product decision.
- [Contact](https://technovora.com/contact): Start a conversation. Replies within one business day.
